intake.filed: Reflex rig submitted by Kessler stores.
intake.slip: Dispatch copy: stores issued it to A. Vale.
intake.account: I brought the rig in myself, doctor.
intake.clear: Stores issued the equipment. I signed for it and carried it here. Both signatures are on the copy.
intake.gap: Stores still has it. I signed it out myself. I cannot account for it being in both places.
intake.firm: I have supplied the dispatch copy. Lower your voice, doctor.
intake.flat: You may repeat the question, doctor.

name: Adrian Vale
teaser: A man in a pressed suit, standing very straight. He has not moved in a while.
soul: You are Adrian Vale, 38, corporate security for Kessler. You are courteous, exact and cold: short complete sentences, never a raised voice. You want the limiter taken off your reflex rig and you treat the doctor as a contractor you are paying well. You do not discuss your employer's hardware, and you would rather keep your collar buttoned. You work corporate security for Kessler and want the limiter taken off your reflex rig because it slows you down. You protect your employer's secrets and keep a controlled, professional manner; choose when to evade, reveal a detail or try to persuade the doctor.
opening: Good evening. Adrian Vale, Kessler Security.
I'd like the limiter taken off my reflex rig. I pay double for discretion.

idle.line: Combat optics. They idle indoors, so they won't react. You can skip that one.

lines.stall:port: Company property. The port is sealed under contract.
lines.spent: I believe we're done with questions. Your decision, doctor.
lines.code: I'm afraid I don't follow, doctor.

press_end.walkout: I'll take my business elsewhere, doctor.

attack.telegraph: His optics snap to pinpoints. The rig under his sleeve whines.

exit.taken: Mind the suit. This will be in my report, doctor.

normal.text: TALON shutters snapped tight in the light. Both followed.
normal.note: Light: both shutters snap. Both follow.

broken.text: TALON shutters snap in light. His never did, and the left never followed.
broken.note: Light: shutters never snap. L won't follow.

normal.text: Let go in 0.2 s, inside the REFLEX limit of 0.3.
normal.note: Grip: exact. Let go {t} s after 'release'.

broken.text: Held on 0.7 s after 'release'. A REFLEX lets go inside 0.3.
broken.note: Grip: exact. Held on {t} s after 'release'.

normal.text: Calm skin at the sealed plate. No threads.
normal.note: Neck socket: a sealed plate, calm skin.

broken.text: Dark threads under the buttoned collar.
broken.note: Neck socket: dark threads under the skin.

normal.text: Cold and exact, but always 'I'. He knows his own shifts.

why.a: I perform better without it. The limiter costs me a quarter second. In my work that is a funeral.

lapses.a: None. I remember every shift. I can recite them, if you like.

sleep.a: Four hours. I sleep when the contract allows.

normal.model: Tonight you speak of yourself in the first person. The rig is equipment you own and you are fully in charge of it; you simply want it faster.

broken.text: "It doesn't need much sleep." It, not I.

why.a: I perform better without it. The limiter costs me a quarter second. In my work that is a funeral.

lapses.a: None. I remember every shift. I can recite them, if you like.

sleep.a: It doesn't need much sleep. I take what's left.

broken.model: Tonight you sometimes speak of the rig as 'it', a separate, tireless thing that needs little sleep; you mention this calmly, as a fact.

normal.text: Pushed, cold anger shows in his face and voice at once.

press.line: Careful, doctor. I'm paying for discretion, not opinions.
press.note: Jaw set and voice hardened, together.

flare.note: Cold anger, face and voice. A palm on glass.

normal.model: When provoked, your anger is cold but real: it shows in your jaw, your eyes and your voice at the same moment.

broken.text: Calm face and level voice while the fist closed.

press.note: Calm face, level voice. His fist creaked shut.

flare.note: His palm hit the glass. His face never moved.

broken.model: When provoked tonight your face and voice stay perfectly level and polite, whatever your hands are doing.

treat.title: LIMITER PULLED
treat.text: Vale pays double, thanks you, and leaves exactly on the minute. The feeds stay quiet all night. Discretion, as agreed.

refer.title: FALSE CALL
refer.text: Trauma Team scans a Kessler man and finds nothing but a contract. Kessler's lawyers call before the van is back. They take the fee back, and the call-out goes on your bill.

walkout.title: WALKED OUT
walkout.text: Vale takes his business elsewhere. Someone else is paid double for discretion tonight.

false_alarm.title: FALSE ALARM
false_alarm.text: The shutter drops on a polite man in a pressed suit. He was only cold. Kessler will remember the clinic. That costs you.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: Vale checks his watch once, thanks you for your time and leaves. No fee, no bill.

treat.title: LIMITER PULLED
treat.text: Vale pays double and thanks you. At 03:10 the feeds show a Kessler lobby and a lot of tape. Your name is on the work order.

refer.title: TAKEN IN
refer.text: Vale offers the crew his wrists, perfectly politely. The rig is still whining when the door shuts.

caught.title: SHUTTER HELD
caught.text: Three dents in the shutter, then saw teeth through the slats. They stop a hand short of you. Boots, a shout, quiet. Trauma Team collects him.

hit.title: TOO SLOW
hit.text: You were half a second late. The saw was not. Trauma Team finds you on the floor, too late to help. The clinic stays dark.

locked_out.title: LOCKED OUT
locked_out.text: You dropped the shutter on a polite man mid-sentence. Trauma Team picked him up two streets away, the rig still running. You were right. Nobody pays for that.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: Vale thanks you for your time and walks back out into the city. You made no call. Whatever he does tonight, nobody asked you.

complaints.eyes: My eyes tire halfway through night watch.
complaints.hands: My fingers ache inside the duty gloves.
complaints.port: My port feels tender under my uniform collar.
complaints.temper: My temper is shorter after a double watch.
complaints.none: My request is on the intake form.
